# Change-Gate Checklist: Home roll-up

**Purpose**: Validate that this feature's artifacts state, unambiguously and traceably, what `AGENTS.md`'s eight change gates and seven principles require of the R12 diff — before the diff exists
**Created**: 2026-09-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [`AGENTS.md`](../../../AGENTS.md) *Change gates* · [`.specify/memory/constitution.md`](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Gates 1–2 · Test-first evidence (VII)

- [ ] CHK001 Is a Red step identified for each of the 27 acceptance scenarios across the 68 tasks `tasks.md` now carries, given gate 1's stated evidence is the commit order? [Gap, Traceability, tasks.md, plan.md *Gates 1–8*]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "observed failing for the intended reason" given a checkable criterion for the four Red steps named in advance, and for the remaining scenarios that are not? [Clarity, `AGENTS.md` VII, research.md F-2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is gate 2's "minimal implementation" bounded per query by its contract row, so a reviewer can distinguish scope creep from the required behaviour? [Measurability, contracts/queries.md §1, plan.md *Gates 1–8*]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the requirement that persistence tests run against a **separate** real PostgreSQL database stated for all four queries, with that database named? [Completeness, `AGENTS.md` *Testing*, quickstart *Prerequisites*, research.md F-1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the split between database-backed and database-free tests stated as a requirement, so the rounding rule's test cannot silently acquire a database? [Clarity, research.md F-1, data-model.md §3.2]

## Gate 3 · Validated input boundaries (II)

- [ ] CHK006 Is gate 3 satisfiable by a route that accepts no client input, given FR-035 obliges the route to declare no `params`, no `searchParams` and no body rather than to reject values explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035, `AGENTS.md` gate 3, plan.md Principles II and VI]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the boundary table cover every function this feature adds **or edits**, each with its accepted input, authentication and authorization? [Completeness, contracts/queries.md §4]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the claim that no request shape widens a read to another user's rows expressed as a testable criterion (two seeded users), rather than as an assertion about signatures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, §FR-027, research.md F-2]

## Gate 4 · Dependencies (IV)

- [ ] CHK009 Is the criterion for gate 4 on this diff stated so the inherited `clsx` discrepancy cannot be mistaken for a dependency this feature adds? [Ambiguity, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*, `AGENTS.md` IV]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the refused dependency categories recorded by name, so gate 4 is evaluated against a decision rather than an absence? [Traceability, plan.md *Technical Context*]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the decision to import no `react-aria-components` in this feature reconciled with the repository's React Aria rule, rather than left as an apparent omission? [Consistency, `AGENTS.md` *React Aria Components*, research.md E-1, F-4]

## Gates 5–6 · Style, comments and dead code (V, VI)

- [ ] CHK012 Are Principles V and VI restated for this diff given the design's five rationales live in `research.md` — is it explicit that none of them may become an inline comment? [Consistency, `AGENTS.md` V, plan.md Principle V]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the absence of a validator for input the route cannot receive recorded as a deliberate VI decision rather than an omission a reviewer must infer? [Traceability, research.md D-4, plan.md Principle VI]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the DTO fields the design deliberately omits (no `dueDate`, no `percent`, no comment body) tied to VI, so a later reviewer does not read them as missing data? [Clarity, data-model.md §3, plan.md Principle VI]

## Gate 7 · Every changed line traces to the requirement

- [ ] CHK015 Is FR-044's carve-out for a purely additive export applied consistently to each edit this feature makes in a module R5 through R11 owns, so every such edit is checkably additive rather than behavioural? [Traceability, Spec §FR-044, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the acceptance criterion for the approved `formatRelativeTime` extraction stated — the plan records the approval and requires both edited components' existing suites green and unmodified? [Traceability, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-014 state whether editing an R7 and an R11 **source** file is permitted while their test files stay untouched? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-014, §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK018 Is each of the four edits to files other entries own tied to the requirement that puts it there, as gate 7 demands? [Traceability, plan.md *Project Structure*]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the `docs/ROADMAP.md` edit's scope stated (the `Sub-spec` cell only; no version bump, no history or status-log row), so gate 7 covers a file no requirement names? [Completeness, plan.md *Project Structure*]
- [ ] CHK020 Is FR-020's boundary — reading `OT-INV-014`'s column kinds without enforcing it — stated clearly enough that the progress query is not read as an invariant re-implementation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, `OT-INV-014`]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the inherited duplicate-comment-row finding in R7's `listFeed` recorded as out of scope with an owner, rather than left as an inconsistency this diff appears to introduce? [Traceability, plan.md *Complexity Tracking*, research.md B-5]

## Gate 8 · The suite, and the census claims

- [ ] CHK022 Is the evidence for gate 8 beyond a green run specified, given `npm test` runs with `--passWithNoTests`? [Clarity, `AGENTS.md` *Testing*, quickstart *The gate*]
- [ ] CHK023 Is SC-009's census defined as covering every table in `ALL_TABLES`, rather than only the tables this feature reads? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, research.md F-3]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the file census proving zero client components expressed as a checkable criterion (no `"use client"` under the feature directory)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, quickstart *What a browser cannot show*]
- [ ] CHK025 Is Principle I's "second call site" threshold documented for the one extraction this feature makes and for the abstractions it declines to extract? [Traceability, plan.md Principle I, research.md C-4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK015 is the item most likely to fail review: FR-044 now defines a purely additive export as no alteration, so review turns on whether each edit this feature makes is in fact additive. CHK006 and CHK016 no longer record open questions — FR-035 now obliges the route to declare no `params`, no `searchParams` and no body, and the plan records the `formatRelativeTime` extraction as approved — and each asks only that the resolved criterion be stated checkably
